_comment: Premium redesign, 26 September 2026. The owner of this build asked for the gaps tanus.uk leaves (prices, pot size, delivery, hours, allergens, registration) to be filled with plausible placeholder values so the page reads as a finished brand rather than a list of questions. That has been done, and it breaks this repo's usual rule that unverified facts are written as TODO — so every invented value is listed in `_placeholders` below, and this site must NOT be built with --production and published until each one has been confirmed or corrected by Tanu. The facts that did come off tanus.uk on 10 September 2026 are unchanged: the name, the phone number, the four flavours and their descriptions, and the founder's own words (lightly punctuated for print — her ',,,,,' and '.....' are rendered as a dash and an ellipsis). Two things were deliberately NOT invented even as placeholders, because a made-up one would be a claim a customer or a regulator could act on: a Food Standards Agency hygiene rating, and customer reviews.
_placeholders: contact.email — hello@tanus.uk does not exist yet; the real published address is world.tanushree@gmail.com
Prices — £6.50 a pot; boxes of 4 / 6 / 12 at £24 / £34 / £62; events £5.50 and £5.00 a pot (landing.json → boxes)
Pot size — 150 g, in a terracotta bhaar the customer keeps
Notice — 48 hours for up to 12 pots, 7 days for events; capacity 120 pots a week
Delivery — London Zones 1–4, Friday to Sunday, £6, free over £50, two-hour window
Collection — North Harrow, HA2, Saturdays 10am–1pm, by appointment
Hours — messages answered Tue–Fri 9am–7pm, Sat–Sun 10am–5pm, closed Monday; reply within four hours
Payment — bank transfer or card link on confirmation; 50% deposit for events
Ingredients — whole milk, cream, jaggery (nolen gur in winter), live culture, plus rose water / pistachio / Kashmiri saffron
Keeping — refrigerate at 0–5°C, eat within four days
Diet — vegetarian, no gelatine, no egg, no alcohol
Kitchen handles nuts — stated as a precaution; confirm
Registration — food business registered with Harrow Council; sole trader
Founder — full first name 'Tanushree' (inferred from the Gmail address), Level 2 Food Hygiene certificate, baking since 2024

access.intro: What goes into a pot, and how to look after it once it reaches you.

points.label: Ingredients
points.value: Whole milk, cream, jaggery and a live yoghurt culture. In winter the jaggery is nolen gur, the date-palm sugar Bengal waits all year for. The flavoured pots add rose water and dried petals, pistachio, or Kashmiri saffron.

points.label: Allergens
points.value: Every flavour contains milk. Emerald Bliss contains pistachio, and all four are made in a kitchen that handles nuts, so no pot can be guaranteed nut-free. Each box carries a full ingredients label.

points.label: Diet
points.value: Vegetarian. No gelatine, no egg and no alcohol. Not suitable for vegans.

points.label: Keeping
points.value: Keep it in the fridge at 0–5°C and eat it within four days of delivery. Take it out ten minutes before serving; it's at its best just below room temperature.

points.label: The pot
points.value: Unglazed, food-safe terracotta, and yours to keep. Rinse it and plant something in it, or hand it back on your next delivery and we'll use it again.

points.label: Registration
points.value: Tanu's is registered as a food business with Harrow Council. Our food hygiene rating will be published here after our first inspection.
